issues.description: The problem asks for the IDs of all Radwege that lead to Gemeinden in Oberfranken or Unterfranken, but the solution query selects Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name instead of an identifier/ID column. This mismatch will cause the solution to return the wrong attribute (name instead of ID) and likely fail tests or confuse students about which column to output.
issues.suggestedFix: Modify the solution query to select the Radweg ID column (e.g. Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_id or the appropriate ID field) instead of Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.name. Keep the existing join and region filter and do not remove duplicates (do not use DISTINCT), for example: SELECT Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.radweg_id FROM Radweg_zu_Gemeinde, Gemeinde WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Radweg_zu_Gemeinde.gemeindeschluessel AND (Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Oberfranken' OR Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk='Unterfranken').
